newsitem.title: USA: World Airways in $18 mln wet lease pact.
newsitem.headline: World Airways in $18 mln wet lease pact.

text.p: World Airways Inc said on Monday it received a wet lease agreement valued at $18 million, to operate a MD-11 aircraft on behalf of a unnamed European carrier.
Wet leasing involved leasing the aircraft, the insurance, the flight crew and the maintenance, while dry leasing was simply the leasing of the aircraft, the company said.

World Airways said it would supply the aircraft, cockpit, crew, maintenance and insurance from June 1997 through February 1998. It said it would operate the plane to various points in the United States for 400 block hours a month.
